# Fixture

## Skills

- [`manual`](skills/manual/) ([Install](docs/install.md#manual)) - A user-invoked skill that calls a helper.
- [`helper`](skills/helper/) ([Install](docs/install.md#helper)) - A model-invoked skill.
- [`pointer`](skills/pointer/) ([Install](docs/install.md#pointer)) - Names the user-invoked skill without calling it.
- [`extra`](skills/extra/) ([Install](docs/install.md#extra)) - A skill nothing depends on.
